title: Forever Boring But Big
author: Alasdair Botting
desc:
Great for people looking to gain some muscle.

Not a good option for athletes, true beginners, and very advanced lifters.

3/5/1 programing

5s Pro

85% Training Max for most lifters, 90% for beginners.

Conditioning:
Maximum of 2 days of hard conditioning
3-5 days of easy conditioning

ex.note:
Jumps/Throws: 10-20 reps of one of the following:
Box Jumps
Standing Long Jump
Standing Hurdle Jump
Standing Triple Jump
Bounding Box Jump
Over Head Med Ball Throw
Backward MB Throw
Chest Pass

Pull: 25-50 reps
Pick one of the following:
Chin-ups/Pull-ups
Inverted Rows
Rows
Curls
Lat Pulldown
Band Pull-Aparts
Face Pulls
Rear Laterals
Upright Row
Shrugs

Push: 25-50 reps
Pick one of the following:
Dips
Pushups
Dumbbell Press
Triceps Extensions/Pushdowns
Full Range Plate Raise

Single Leg/Core: 0-50 reps
Pick one of the following:
Back Raises/Reverse Hyper
Glute Ham Raise
SLDL/ Good Morning
Abdominal Work (Various)
KB Swing
Farmers Walk
Step Ups
Lunge Variation
Bulgarian SS
